hook: Your snake actors play dead, cash in their death scenes, then the whole cast stands up bigger for the bow.
loop: Seat units so the right ones go down beside the right neighbours
Each fall plays dead and triggers Death Scenes for permanent stats
Curtain Call: the limp cast rises at full Health, grown

growth.line: Permanent stats each time a unit goes down; from Tier 4, extra triggers multiply every scene, even in the shop.

feel.early: Cheap Play Dead bodies that refuse to stay down
feel.mid: Seating puzzle: Bufo and Mixer grow every fall
feel.late: Hesketh and Old Crest replay the whole repertoire

stars.why: Knocks a friend down before the fight, so scenes pay early
Feeds every limp unit, so the second act rises bigger
His fall plays every other Death Scene at once

card_short.u02: Gains Attack permanently whenever another friend plays dead
card_short.u03: Death Scene: permanently buffs the units beside it
card_short.u04: Start of Combat: lends Play Dead to the unit in front
card_short.u05: Gold next turn for units that went down, up to 2
card_short.u06: When played: triggers a friend's Death Scene in the shop
card_short.u07: When played: permanently gives a friend Play Dead
card_short.u08: Death Scene: permanently buffs your other Play Dead units
card_short.u09: Neighbour goes down: summons a Tail carrying its Death Scene
card_short.u10: Start of Combat: the unit on her left goes down
card_short.u11: Each friend that plays dead gets permanent stats
card_short.u12: Start of Turn: get a Saucer of Milk
card_short.u13: Play Dead; units playing dead trigger their scenes again
card_short.u14: Plays dead twice; Death Scene permanently buffs all others
card_short.u15: Play Dead; Death Scene destroys the enemy that downed it
card_short.u16: All your Death Scenes trigger again, even while recruiting
card_short.u17: Play Dead; Death Scene triggers all your other scenes
card_short.u18: Play Dead; your Play Dead units get one more life
card_short.u19: Permanently eats half the stats of friends that really die
card_short.x01: 1/1 carrying the fallen neighbour's Death Scene
card_short.x02: Item: 1 gold, lend Play Dead, or trigger a scene

builds.name: The Long Death Scene
builds.line: Mixer, Wreath-Weaver, Natrix and Old Crest grow the board permanently; Hesketh caps it

builds.name: The Second Act
builds.line: Chorus Snakes, Bufo and Žilvinas: the whole cast rises again, bigger

builds.name: The Villain's Prologue
builds.line: Coronella downs Berus or Hesketh before the first attack

liked: Coronella, the Villain: all three picked her; scenes pay before combat
Seating who goes down next to whom is a real puzzle
worries: Sir Hesketh with Old Crest and Eft multiplies every scene, even in shop
Berus destroys outright; Žilvinas's extra lives make fights long and hard to follow
changed: Risen units keep spare Play Dead lives, so more Curtain Calls can come
Little Anguis now just drops a Tail carrying a fallen neighbour's scene
Natterjack pays per unit down; Saucers can trigger a Death Scene
verdict: Rated 7 fun, 7 distinct, settled, ranked second of three; for players who love arranging chains of death effects and comebacks.
